meta.description: Honest, sourced comparisons of Munib Tracker with Muslim Pro, Islam360, Tarteel, Pillars, Athan and other Salah and habit tracker apps.

title: Compare Munib Tracker with other Islamic apps
intro: Every Muslim app makes different choices about features, ads, price and privacy. These comparisons use each app's official website and store listings, list their sources, and say plainly where another app is the better fit.

note.title: How we compare
note.text: We only list what we can confirm from official sources, and mark everything else “Not verified”. We never invent weaknesses. Each page shows the date it was last checked. If something has changed, please [let us know](/contact).

cta.title: See for yourself
cta.text: Munib Tracker is free with no ads or account. Try it alongside your current app.
